item.title: A Guide to Which AI CEOs Now Say ‘Super Intelligence’ and Which Don’t
item.description:
[Artificial Intelligence](https://gizmodo.com/tech/artificial-intelligence)
# A Guide to Which AI CEOs Now Say ‘Super Intelligence’ and Which Don’t _Artificial intelligence_ or _AI_ started out in the 1950s as an observation about the potential capabilities of computer systems.
President, Donald Trump, decided last month that he didn’t want to call artificial intelligence “artificial intelligence” anymore, and that he wanted to use his own alternative phrase instead: “Super Intelligence,” which is two words in title case. He has [since said](https://gizmodo.com/youll-never-guess-who-trump-is-now-calling-the-enemy-2000823614) anyone who still says “artificial intelligence” is “THE ENEMY.”
## ❓ Amodei, Dario ![CEO of Anthropic Dario Amodei looks on as U.S. President Donald Trump holds a press briefing with AI executives following a meeting on artificial intelligence, outside the West Wing of the White House on September 29, 2026 in Washington, DC.](https://gizmodo.com/app/uploads/2026/10/dario-at-white-house-2026.jpg)© Kevin Dietsch / Getty Images
## ✅ Nadella, Satya The post refers to safety tech that “eludes us in today’s Super Intelligence systems, even as the frontier models powering these systems are now more capable than traditional software systems,” making it clear that he’s not referring to hypothetical “superintelligence” in the future, but to artificial intelligence generally.
